name: Eisa Limited
summary: ASX-listed regional ISP roll-up (Eisa Limited, ASX: EIS, ACN 077 368 257, registered 05 Feb 1997), trading as 'Edge Internet Services Australia' (eisa.net.au, brand line 'Ride the wave with Edge Internet Services Australia'; Melbourne helpline 03 9416 0099). Ran regional ISP brands including Internet North (Cairns/FNQ, folded into this entity as the 'Eisa Internet North' brand), Dynamite (Canberra, since 1991) and Topend.Com.Au (Darwin/Katherine NT) - all acquired independents (see roll-up note), ~4,500 subs; folded into this entity as the 'Eisa Internet North' brand) and held 1997 IP-index allocations (EISA-AU, EISA001, EDGEINTERNETSER2/3/4-AU; Melbourne and Wickham NSW). Administrator appointed 21 Sep 2000; business sold to Austar United Broadband for $13m (06 Oct 2000); delisted 30 Aug 2001; deregistered 26 Aug 2003.
aliases: Edge Internet Services Australia Pty Ltd

events.details: Regional ISP roll-up: acquired/operated regional ISP brands as business names of Eisa Limited (ACN 077 368 257) - 'EISA INTERNET NORTH' (Cairns/Far North Queensland, ~4,500 subs; POPs Cairns, Mossman, Innisfail, Atherton; business name 17 Apr 2000 - 28 Jun 2001; folded into this entity as a brand), 'EISA TOPEND' (Darwin NT; see topend-com-au), 'EISA DYNAMITE' (Canberra ACT; see dynamite-internet), plus TOPEND.COM.AU. Internet North was an independent FNQ ISP predating Eisa: 1997 IP-index allocation INTERNETNORTH-AU 203.14.120.0/22 (PO Box 11, Manunda QLD 4870). Dynamite (Canberra, born 25 Aug 1995; ACN 072 264 012) and Topend.Com.Au (NT) were acquired independents with their own entities and acquisition transitions. Eisa entered administration 21 Sep 2000; its regional ISP business incl. Internet North sold to Austar United Broadband 06 Oct 2000 (NSWSC 940).
